steps: Hold your dominant hand open in front of your chest, fingers extended and pointing upward, palm facing forward.
Raise your hand in a smooth motion from chest level to just below your chin.
Curl your fingers into a firm fist as your hand rises, ending with your knuckles facing forward.
Keep your other hand relaxed and still at your side throughout the sign.
tip: Picture snatching a prize out of the air — your hand grabs shut as it rises.

steps: Make a firm fist with your dominant hand, wrapping your thumb across your fingers.
Raise the fist to the middle of your chest, holding it a short distance in front of your body.
Turn your wrist so the back of your hand faces forward, with your knuckles pointing away from you.
Hold the fist still in that position for a moment, keeping your other hand relaxed at your side.
tip: A still, clenched fist shows a firm grip — the stillness is part of the sign.

steps: Form a V with each hand by extending your index and middle fingers, keeping the other fingers curled.
Hold both V hands in front of your upper chest, fingers pointing upward, palms facing each other.
Swing both hands down toward your waist, rotating your wrists so the V fingers point downward.
Swing your hands back up to chest height, rotating so the V fingers point upward again.
Repeat the up-and-down swing, letting the two Vs bounce together like dancing legs.
tip: The two V shapes are a pair of dancing legs bouncing up and down together.

steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat in front of your waist, palm facing upward like a small platform.
Form a V with your dominant hand by extending your index and middle fingers, keeping the rest curled.
Point the two V fingers straight down above your upturned palm, with the back of your hand facing forward.
Lower the V fingertips onto your palm so the two fingers stand upright on it, then hold briefly.
tip: Two fingers are the legs and your flat palm is the ground — the legs stand on it.

steps: Make loose fists with both hands, as if gripping a cloth in each hand, palms facing forward.
Hold both fists in front of your torso, between chest and waist height.
Scrub the fists up and down alternately, raising one fist as the other lowers.
Repeat the alternating polishing motion, like buffing a surface until it shines.
tip: Two fists take turns polishing — the alternating scrub is the heart of this sign.

steps: Make a fist with your dominant hand and stick your thumb out sideways, palm facing down.
Hold the fist at the center of your chest with the thumb pointing across toward your other side.
Sweep your hand outward toward your dominant side in a smooth, arcing motion.
Rotate your wrist as you sweep so the thumb finishes pointing straight up, palm facing inward.
tip: The thumb travels onward and pops up — what comes after moves forward in time.

steps: Hold your non-dominant hand up in front of your chest, fingers extended together.
Point your dominant index finger downward, curling your other fingers into your palm.
Tap the tip of your index finger once onto the back of your other hand near the wrist.
Keep the tap light and brief, like pointing at an imaginary watch on your wrist.
tip: Tap the wrist where a watch sits — one tap marks a month.

steps: Bend the fingers of both hands into loose claws, as if holding a small ball in each hand.
Hold both hands in front of your waist, palms facing downward, a short distance apart.
Move both hands forward together in a winding, snake-like path, swaying gently side to side.
Keep the claw shapes steady as your hands meander forward like a winding river.
tip: Your winding hands trace the meandering course of a river.

steps: Hold both hands flat in front of your chest, fingers extended and slightly spread, palms facing down.
Start with your hands close together at the center of your chest.
Sweep both hands outward to your sides in a smooth, wavy motion, like rolling waves.
Finish with your arms extended wide, palms still facing down toward the water surface.
tip: Flat hands roll outward like waves spreading across the water.

steps: Hold both hands open in front of your waist, fingers extended together, palms facing inward.
Start with your hands low and wide apart, like the broad base of a mountain.
Raise both hands diagonally upward and inward, tracing the two slopes of the mountain.
Touch your fingertips together at chest height to form the pointed peak, then hold.
tip: Your hands climb the slopes and meet at the summit.
